title: qa test suites (qa/suites.json)
description: The commands that run the project's tests. A `test` expectation (expectations.json) names a suite and the test in it; qa runs only that test (and only its file, when the entry names one), never the whole suite. A mutant's kill test names a suite too, and `qa ready` runs each suite whole once to prove it names its tests. A playwright, vitest, jest, pytest or node --test command (an argv list, or a string with no ; & | < > ` or $( in it) gets the name filter, the file and a machine-readable reporter added at its end; any other command gets QA_TEST_GREP, QA_TEST_FILE and QA_TEST_REPORT in its env and may use them. A .ts/.mjs suites file exports SUITES with the same values. These used to be the SUITES of qa/mutants.*, which qa still reads while a project has no suites file.

anyOf.description: 'test:<level>' runs the stack adapter's test verb with that level. Any other string is a shell command, run with bash -c in the worktree
argv run directly in the worktree; argv[0] is the program

timeoutMs.description: The limit of one run of this suite, replacing qa.json mutants.timeoutMs (default 900000)

covers.description: The globs of the source files this suite's tests exercise. A re-verify round re-runs a test row of this suite, carried from an earlier round, when the fix changes a file one of them matches; without covers a test row re-runs only when its own test file changes
